Programs

Our Fotona laser programs

Three Fotona laser programs: NightLase for snoring, Fotona Lift for anti-ageing and PigmentControl for pigmentation.

Snoring treatment · Fotona

NightLase

Reduces snoring with laser — no surgery or discomfort

NightLase is a non-invasive treatment that reduces snoring with the Fotona laser (SMOOTH mode). The Er:YAG laser applies gentle, controlled heat to the tissues of the palate, stimulating collagen and tightening the mucosa to help keep the airway more open.

It's comfortable with no downtime: each session lasts under 30 minutes, no anaesthesia, and you can resume your day right away. A course of 3 sessions is recommended for optimal results.

Why NightLase

  • Non-invasive, no surgery
  • No anaesthesia or downtime
  • Sessions under 30 minutes
  • Progressively reduces snoring

PigmentControl

Pigmentation control with Fotona laser

At Impuls we work on pigmentation progressively over 12 months with the Fotona laser, one of the most advanced for spots.

Unlike a single session, this approach achieves visible, lasting results, not temporary ones.

The first session includes

  • Professional skin diagnosis
  • Personalised protocol for your case
  • Full Fotona laser session
  • Home care guidance
